sentences.en: Reproduction is asexual when there is no fusion of gametes.
sentences.zh: 当没有配子融合时，繁殖是无性繁殖。

sentences.en: The physicist was aware of the potential danger of nuclear fusion.
sentences.zh: 那位物理学家意识到了核聚变潜在的危害。

sentences.en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
sentences.zh: 爵士融合将摇滚乐与爵士乐结合在一起。

senses.zh: （不同特质、思想等的）合成体，融合体；合为一体；融合
